english.title: User of vehicle fail to give information re keeper
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person alleged to have used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road in contravention of section 29 of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994, failed to give information which it was in your power to give as to the identity of the person keeping the said vehicle at the time as you were required to give by or on behalf of the

(A)_[Chief Officer of Police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE..)]_
(B)_[Secretary of State]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(4) and (5) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
